notes.title: Set Building System Update - Cine Tracer 2 (0.4.0)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7KKz4QWjMIg;full][/previewyoutube]

Cine Tracer 2 (0.4.0) is a large system update that will not open older saves.  Previous versions of the game are available as Steam Branches.

This update unifies all of the "Tools" into a single radial menu.  There is a new "Furniture Tool" that helps place furniture perfectly against walls and on a simple building grid.

notes.title: Updates Notes (v0.1.3) Living Room Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7RQbQHONYAo;full][/previewyoutube]

This update adds a new Living Room + Kitchen set with new furniture and assets.  For film equipment there is a new C-Stand + Flag rig.  There are two new clothing options and one new actor pose for the couch.

Please watch the YouTube videos for walkthrough of the new assets.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.1.2 "Bedroom" Update
notes.notes:
This is the first update to Cine Tracer 2 for PC and MacOS.  There is a new Bedroom map with new lighting controls.  There is also a new 12x12 Frame Light in the inventory.  Please watch the YouTube walkthrough video for more details.

[previewyoutube=Srm-yjIKNOU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cine Tracer 2 v0.1.1 First Public Release
notes.notes: This update brings the very first tutorial map, shot list, and inventory system.  This release is still very experimental and should not be used for serious long term productions.
